## Description {#details}

<p>C++ header file with inline implementations for the µTest++ expression formatter.</p>


<p>This header provides the inline and template method implementations for <span class="doxyComputerOutput">expression_formatter</span>. The buffer accessors (<span class="doxyComputerOutput">str()</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">c_str()</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">clear()</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">empty()</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">append()</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">reserve()</span>) are defined as inline functions for zero-overhead access. The template operators — <span class="doxyComputerOutput">operator&lt;&lt;(T*)</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">operator&lt;&lt;(is_op&lt;T&gt;)</span>, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">operator&lt;&lt;(genuine_integral_value&lt;T&gt;)</span>, and <span class="doxyComputerOutput">operator&lt;&lt;(container)</span> — are instantiated per concrete type at each call site.</p>


<p>The <span class="doxyComputerOutput">append_number_()</span> helper is also a template, selecting between a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">std::to_chars</span> path for standard numeric types and an <span class="doxyComputerOutput">snprintf</span> fallback for <span class="doxyComputerOutput">long double</span> on platforms where <span class="doxyComputerOutput">std::to_chars</span> lacks support for 80-bit extended precision.</p>


<p>All definitions reside within the <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/namespaces/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus">micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus</a></span> namespace.</p>


<p>This file is intended solely for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.</p>
